title: The Stolen Chess Queen
crime_description: The grandmaster tournament's carved ivory queen piece was substituted with a salt shaker wrapped in tinfoil.
setting: St. Jude Chess Club Tournament Hall

suspect.name: Boris 'Gambit' Vronsky
suspect.occupation: Former Chess Grandmaster turned Pretzel Vendor
suspect.quirk: Analyzes every life situation as a chess opening or endgame blunder.

dossier.text: A smear of coarse sea salt and sesame pretzel glaze was found on the championship board square d1.
Boris's motorized pretzel cart was photographed parked illegally outside the club back door at 7:45 PM.
The roll of heavy-duty aluminum foil used to wrap the shaker was purchased with Boris's loyalty card at 7:15 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Boris buys aluminum foil at the corner market with his store loyalty card.
Boris parks his pretzel cart by the tournament hall fire escape.
Boris sneaks to board 1 with pretzel glaze on his fingers, swiping the ivory queen.

lie_plan.cover_story: Boris claims he was three miles away selling gluten-free churros without sesame or salt, never drove his cart near St. Jude, and never bought tinfoil in his life.

weak_points.claim: My confectionery inventory uses only powdered sugar; I never touch coarse rock salt or pretzel glaze.
weak_points.planned_slip: A tactical blunder by the prosecution! My fingertips are coated solely in sweet powdered sugar; I have handled no coarse sea salt nor sesame pretzel syrup today!

weak_points.claim: My pretzel vehicle remained parked in the East District depot all evening.
weak_points.planned_slip: Checkmate, inspector! My mobile cart never visited the alley of St. Jude at 7:45 PM; it was securely stationed miles away!

weak_points.claim: I have no grocery loyalty account and have never purchased aluminum kitchen foil.
weak_points.planned_slip: An illegal move! I hold no loyalty club memberships and purchased zero aluminum foil rolls at 7:15 PM or ever!

solution_contradictions: Suspect claims he never handles sea salt or pretzel glaze, contradicting Fact 1 (salt and pretzel glaze found on square d1).
Suspect claims his cart was parked miles away, contradicting Fact 2 (cart photographed outside club at 7:45 PM).
Suspect claims he has no loyalty card and bought no foil, contradicting Fact 3 (foil purchased on his loyalty card at 7:15 PM).
